description: This file defines several enum classes representing various command and capability constants used in the OpenClaw Android application protocol. Each enum class provides raw string values for specific commands related to different device features, and some include companion objects with namespace prefixes.

classes.name: OpenClawCapability
classes.description: Enumeration of device capabilities that can be accessed or controlled.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasCommand
classes.description: Commands related to canvas operations such as presentation, hide, navigation, evaluation, and snapshot.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UICommand
classes.description: Commands for interacting with the canvas A2UI, including push, push JSON lines, and reset actions.

classes.name: OpenClawCameraCommand
classes.description: Commands for camera operations such as listing cameras, snapping photos, and clipping.

classes.name: OpenClawSmsCommand
classes.description: Commands for SMS operations like sending and searching messages.

classes.name: OpenClawLocationCommand
classes.description: Command for obtaining the device location.

classes.name: OpenClawDeviceCommand
classes.description: Commands to get device status, information, permissions, and health.

classes.name: OpenClawNotificationsCommand
classes.description: Commands to list notifications and perform actions on them.

classes.name: OpenClawPhotosCommand
classes.description: Command to get the latest photos.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsCommand
classes.description: Commands for searching and adding contacts.

classes.name: OpenClawCalendarCommand
classes.description: Commands for handling calendar events and additions.

classes.name: OpenClawMotionCommand
classes.description: Commands related to device motion activity detection and pedometer.
